reviews.t: Highly recommend! Can I give 10 stars??
reviews.x: Love this, I'm a natural golden blond and I've been doing dark red and purple for about 6 months. I did 2 treatments within a few hours and have a honey blond with some awesome highlights! The odor does smell bad. But it's totally worth the results. Best thing my hair doesn't feel any more damaged than it did before I did this. I have enough left in the bottles for one more treatment that I'll try in a few days. Thank you Saleem for this amazing product! Saved me hundreds of dollars at the salon

reviews.t: Works good for product without bleach or ammonia

Salermo Color Reverse removed most of the demi-permanent color I've been using. It works pretty good for having no bleach or ammonia-(however it does have an ammonia smell, so expect that). I'd recommend not using it more than twice depending the condition of your hair. For my hair, I'm using it just twice. The 2n

It works !!! So I’ve been dying my hair jet black for around a year with different semi permanent colors. I eventually got tired of it and decided to go red ☺️. I had to lift the jet black dye out of my hair and I wanted to try a method without lightener. The smell of this stinks really bad but it’s worth it. I did 2 rounds of this and it has gotten all of the black out of my hair and ends.

reviews.t: Left my hair soft and undamaged
reviews.x: This was a great experience. I used about half of the containers since my hair is so short. I'm including photos of my hair before, faded blue green, and after,  honey blonde and orange (which is about what I bleached it to before putting the blue and green in) my roots are not affected and my hair is so soft. I kept expecting the horrible oder that people mentioned but honestly this wasn't that bad. If you've permed your hair or been to a nail salon this smell should be tolerable.

reviews.t: it lightened up to a medium red color that I am fairly happy with. The product does have a sulfurous odor
reviews.x: I have been dyeing my hair with dark Demi colors for two years, first a dark red, and then a blue/black. Considering that my hair was quite dark, it lightened up to a medium red color that I am fairly happy with. The product does have a sulfurous odor, but that seems par for the course with color removers and it did not leave my hair damaged.

I had low hopes for this product honestly but it shocked me. I bought it because Color Oops was out of stock but it worked brilliantly. I expected it to smell horrible (and part one does smell like eggs & farts) but once you mix in the part 2, the bad smell is gone!

claims.text: Most reviewers say the product effectively removes stubborn dye, including red and black, often after one or more applications.
Many reviewers warn that the product has a very strong, foul odor that is hard to tolerate.
Several reviewers note that multiple treatments are often needed to see full results.
Some reviewers report that the product does not damage hair and can even leave it feeling soft.
A few reviewers report disappointing or unexpected outcomes, such as green hair or limited lifting.
